name: arcosian
description: Arcosian: a principal game developer and full studio for Claude Code, for any game on any platform, plus optional adapters for engines, art, levels, audio, asset vendors, commerce, team and community tools.

plugins.name: arcosian
plugins.description: Core plugin: codex, ontology, agents, workflows, simulators, project map, change impact, what-if predictions, dashboard, gateway, templates for phones, desktop and web, and five-gate enforcement.

plugins.name: arcosian-godot
plugins.description: Adapter: Godot's GDScript language server for Claude Code (errors after edits, go to definition, references) plus Godot 4 MCP bridges for runtime verification, input injection and headless export.

plugins.name: arcosian-unity
plugins.description: Adapter: Unity-aware C# language server for Claude Code (csharp-ls) plus Unity CLI and Unity MCP bridges for editor control, play mode, tests and builds.

plugins.name: arcosian-blender
plugins.description: Adapter: Blender MCP for 3D cleanup, retopology, baking and previews.

plugins.name: arcosian-vendors
plugins.description: Adapter: official vendor MCP servers for art, 3D and audio generation (Scenario, PixelLab, Meshy, ElevenLabs, ComfyUI and others).

plugins.name: arcosian-commerce
plugins.description: Adapter: RevenueCat, Firebase, Adjust and app-store MCP servers for monetization, analytics and release.

plugins.name: arcosian-art
plugins.description: 2D art, animation and UI tools: Aseprite, Krita, Spine, Rive, Figma's official MCP server, sprite sheets into Godot and Unity, and notes on Substance and Houdini.

plugins.name: arcosian-levels
plugins.description: Tiled and LDtk level editing: a converter to one level format, reachability and pacing checks that feed the core level audit, and importers for Godot and Unity.

plugins.name: arcosian-audio
plugins.description: FMOD Studio and Wwise for any game: events, banks, engine integration, bank builds in CI, a minimal WAAPI client, and when engine-native audio is enough.

plugins.name: arcosian-community
plugins.description: Team, community and store-page operations: GitHub's and Sentry's official MCP servers, Discord and devlogs, Steam and itch.io community pages, crash triage; every post human-approved.
